rows.en: ＊Amane＊＠０１９＿００１What should I do... Maybe it's￥none of my business...
＊Amane＊＠０１９＿００２Oh, it's you...￥Um, well...￥what should I do...
＊Amane＊＠０１９＿００３Oh... um, see.￥I can't really figure out￥what I should do on my own...
＊Amane＊＠０１９＿００４I was watching the mechanics￥work, and I got an idea, so I￥tried writing a program.
＊Amane＊＠０１９＿００５I think it's a pretty good￥idea, but...
＊Amane＊＠０１９＿００６Is it... okay for me to tell￥them about it...?
＊Amane＊＠０１９＿００７Or would it just be butting in,￥like the other day...?
＊Amane＊＠０１９＿００８Really...?￥You think it'll be okay...?＝＠０１９＿００９You really don't think￥it'll be a bother...?
＊Amane＊＠０１９＿０１２Um, excuse me!＝＠０１９＿０１３It's just a personal idea, but￥could you hear me out,￥just for a bit?

＊Amane＊＠０１９＿０１５I-I think it'd help whenever a￥Worker has a simple breakdown...＝＠０１９＿０１６What if Workers had a built-in￥self-check program so candidates￥could fix them on their own?＝＠０１９＿０１７I went ahead and made one,￥but...

＊Amane＊＠０１９＿０１９With this, anyone who's bad at￥maintenance could see at a￥glance where the problem is...＝＠０１９＿０２０It'd improve everyone's skills,￥and on top of that, it'd save￥you mechanics a lot of work too!
＊Amane＊＠０１９＿０２２B-but this is just my own￥personal idea...＝＠０１９＿０２３So if it's no use, that's￥totally fine...
＊Mechanic＊＠０１９＿０２４No, I think it's a fine system.＝＠０１９＿０２５We'll look it over, but￥a system like this will￥probably be adopted, no problem.
＊Amane＊＠０１９＿０２８No, thank you!￥Sorry for bothering you at work!
＊Amane＊＠０１９＿０２９Yeah... yeah!! I'm so happy!￥Working up the courage...￥it wasn't for nothing!!
＊Amane＊＠０１９＿０３０Yeah!￥I'm so glad I did what￥you said!
＊Amane＊＠０２０＿００２If you don't push your opinions￥on people, and you think about￥their feelings and position...
＊Amane＊＠０２０＿００３then they'll really listen￥to you, won't they?
＊Amane＊＠０２０＿００４Yeah! From now on, I'm sure I￥can get along with the mechanics￥and the engineers!!
＊Amane＊＠０２０＿００５Yeah. Until now... there were￥probably lots of people who got￥mad at the way I acted.
＊Amane＊＠０２０＿００６But from now on, I'll be fine!!￥I'll never make the same￥mistake again!!
＊Amane＊＠０２０＿００７I get it now!＝＠０２０＿００８"Put yourself in other people's￥shoes, and do what they most￥want you to do for them..."＝＠０２０＿００９That's what my mom meant when￥she told me that!
＊Amane＊＠０２０＿０１０And I bet I only realized it￥because you gave me a push!
＊Amane＊＠０２０＿０１２Who knows what would've happened￥if you weren't here?!
＊Amane＊＠０２０＿０１６You're always the one helping me￥out. It's kind of frustrating...
＊Amane＊＠０２０＿０１７One of these days I'll have to￥show you my cooler side, huh?!
＊Amane＊＠０２０＿０１８Well, I'm gonna go look at the￥sunflowers! See ya!!
